Harris and others who make use of the harm threshold in their responses to questions of reproductive ethics draw on Parfit’s non-identity problem. Our intuitive tendency to say that a reproductive decision which results in the conception of a diseased child harms the child is hard to explain if the child could not otherwise have existed.
